svg.title: ohohohoh / olè animated yellow hands
svg.desc: Animated icon with two nicer yellow cartoon-human hands. During the ohohohoh phase both bent hands rotate with exactly the same fast rhythm, outward and inward, while the text appears from left to right. Then the same two hands rise and transition into open olè hands above, again synchronized, with burst rays and the word olè.

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Comic Sans, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif
Comic Sans MS, Comic Sans, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif
